name: poly_cyclotomic_two_mul_odd_comp_neg
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) (h1 : 1 < n) : Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * n) ℤ = (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).comp (-Polynomial.X)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) (h1 : 1 < n), Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * n) ℤ = (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).comp (-Polynomial.X)
informal: For odd n > 1, Φ_{2n}(X) = Φ_n(-X) — Polynomial.cyclotomic_mul_prime_of_not_dvd-type identity Φ_{2n}(X)·Φ_n(X) = Φ_n(X^2) (expand by the prime 2 ∤ n), together with Φ_n(X^2) = Φ_n(X)·Φ_n(-X) up to sign, proved via strong induction on n using X^n - 1 = ∏_{d ∣ n} Φ_d and (-X)^n - 1 = -(X^n + 1) for odd n; φ(n) even for n > 1 fixes the sign.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), Odd n → 1 < n → Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * n) ℤ = (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).comp (-Polynomial.X)
